case.summary: Analyst review for case HHG-002 indicates a fraudulent card-not-present transaction with a calibrated probability of 0.91, driven by high-risk online channel activity and a history of confirmed fraud on both the specific card tuple and a different card associated with the customer. The device is tied to a known hub with a high degree count, while the transaction amount deviated significantly from the card's typical spend pattern. Following contact, the customer explicitly denied making the transaction, confirming the fraudulent nature of the activity. Although similar historical cases involving high-scoring model alerts were ultimately cleared due to verified cardholder travel, the combination of prior fraud history and direct customer denial in case HHG-002 overwhelmingly points to unauthorized use. Per the policy engine decisions, the card will be blocked and a new case has been created.
